 F[\"Output<br/><br/>Time, frame, text, image\"]

 G[\"Fallback scan<br/><br/>Coarse full-video OCR\"]

 A --> B
 B --> C
 C -->|no confident match| G
 C --> D
 G -->|coarse scan| D
 D --> E
 E --> F

 classDef input fill:#f1efe9,stroke:#999,color:#444
 classDef process fill:#e5f1fc,stroke:#6aa5d8,color:#14527d
 classDef decision fill:#eeecff,stroke:#8b83e6,color:#45409a
 classDef fallback fill:#fce9e3,stroke:#d88b73,color:#8b3e22

 class A,F input
 class B,D process
 class C,E decision
 class G fallback",
 "config": null
